notes.title: Part 2 + 3 update
notes.content:
Looks like we have feedback already, and yeah okay we'll speed up the submission and review process for parasite infection part 2 and 3.  It's already built (although there are a few bugs).  These will be directly integrated into the game so if you have bought it already you don't have to do anything, as soon as it is available it will be part of the same game.

I had reservations about part 2 but after talking to people about other content on steam I think I have more confidence it will get approved.

Thank you all for supporting the project so far, we'll continue to monitor feedback and evolve this game to be the best it can be.
